words.enDefinition: A document summarizing a person's borrowing and repayment record

examples.en: I checked my credit report for accounts I did not recognize after moving.
examples.zh: 搬家后，我查看了自己的「信用报告」，看看有没有不认识的账户。

examples.en: Her credit report showed a loan she had paid off two years earlier.
examples.zh: 她的「信用报告」上显示了一笔她两年前就已还清的贷款。

words.enDefinition: A record of how someone has borrowed and repaid money

examples.en: My credit history back home did not appear in the local lender's records.
examples.zh: 我在老家的「信用记录」没有出现在当地贷款机构的档案里。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether I already had a credit history in this country.
examples.zh: 顾问问我在这个国家是否已有「信用记录」。

words.enDefinition: An organization that collects and shares records about people's borrowing

examples.en: The credit bureau asked which account I was disputing before opening the case.
examples.zh: 「征信机构」立案前先问我对哪个账户有异议。

examples.en: I found the credit bureau listed at the bottom of the letter.
examples.zh: 我在信的末尾找到了列出的「征信机构」。

collocations: dispute information with a credit bureau

words.enDefinition: The lowest and highest values allowed by a scoring system

examples.en: The credit score range is printed near the explanation of what each number means.
examples.zh: 「信用评分范围」印在各个分数的含义说明旁边。

examples.en: We checked the credit score range because the two reports used different scoring systems.
examples.zh: 两份报告采用了不同的评分体系，所以我们核对了「信用评分范围」。

collocations: fall within the credit score range
the top of the credit score range

words.enDefinition: A method that turns borrowing information into a numerical score

examples.en: The lender explained which credit scoring model it used when assessing applications for small loans.
examples.zh: 贷款机构解释了审核小额贷款申请时使用哪种「信用评分模型」。

examples.en: The reports use the same data but each uses a different credit scoring model.
examples.zh: 两份报告采用相同的数据，但各自使用不同的「信用评分模型」。

words.enDefinition: A borrowing record containing relatively few accounts or repayment details

examples.en: I had a thin credit file because I only had one local credit card.
examples.zh: 因为我在当地只有一张信用卡，所以「信用档案资料较少」。

examples.en: The adviser explained what a thin credit file meant for this particular application.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「信用档案资料较少」对这次申请意味着什么。

collocations: borrowers with a thin credit file

words.enDefinition: Having no recorded history of borrowing or repaying credit

examples.en: I had no credit history in Canada when I first arrived for university.
examples.zh: 我刚到加拿大上大学时，在当地「没有信用记录」。

examples.en: The lender's form has a separate option for applicants with no credit history.
examples.zh: 贷款机构的表格给「没有信用记录」的申请人单列了一个选项。

words.enDefinition: The period during which someone has had recorded credit accounts

examples.en: The guide explained how the length of credit history differed from a person's actual age.
examples.zh: 指南解释了一个人的「信用记录年限」与实际年龄有何区别。

examples.en: I saw the length of credit history listed among the factors on my score report.
examples.zh: 我看到评分报告把「信用记录年限」列在影响因素里。

collocations: calculate the length of credit history
a minimum length of credit history
factor in the length of credit history

words.enDefinition: The variety of borrowing accounts in a person's credit record

examples.en: The chart grouped my loans and cards together under the heading credit mix.
examples.zh: 图表把我的贷款和信用卡都归在「信贷类型组合」这一栏。

examples.en: A credit card and an installment loan were both included in her credit mix.
examples.zh: 她的「信贷类型组合」既有信用卡，也有分期贷款。

words.enDefinition: Borrowing that can be used again as balances are repaid

examples.en: The booklet listed credit cards as a familiar example of revolving credit.
examples.zh: 手册把信用卡列为「循环信贷」的常见例子。

examples.en: The agreement explained how revolving credit worked when part of the balance was repaid.
examples.zh: 协议解释了偿还部分欠款后「循环信贷」如何运作。

words.enDefinition: Borrowing repaid in scheduled parts over a set period

examples.en: My car loan appears under installment credit in the summary of my accounts.
examples.zh: 我的汽车贷款列在账户汇总的「分期信贷」一栏。

examples.en: The class compared installment credit with the credit available on a card.
examples.zh: 课堂上比较了「分期信贷」和信用卡提供的额度。

words.enDefinition: An account that is no longer open for new activity

examples.en: The closed account still appeared on my report with its original opening date.
examples.zh: 「已关闭账户」仍在我的报告中，并显示原开户日期。

examples.en: I asked why the closed account was shown as active on one report.
examples.zh: 我问为什么有一份报告把这个「已关闭账户」标成了有效。

words.enDefinition: An item showing unfavorable information on a person's credit report

examples.en: I found a negative entry on the report for a loan I never took out.
examples.zh: 我发现报告里有一条「负面记录」，涉及我从没借过的贷款。

examples.en: The negative entry included the name of a company we did not recognize.
examples.zh: 那条「负面记录」里有一家我们不认识的公司。

words.enDefinition: A request made to access someone's credit information

examples.en: I recognized the credit inquiry because I had applied for a card that morning.
examples.zh: 我认得这次「征信查询」，因为那天上午我申请过信用卡。

examples.en: Each credit inquiry on my report showed a company name and a date.
examples.zh: 我的报告中，每次「征信查询」都列有公司名称和日期。

words.enDefinition: A credit check associated with an application that may affect scores

examples.en: I asked if the full application would involve a hard inquiry on my report.
examples.zh: 我问正式申请会不会在我的报告中留下「硬性征信查询」记录。

examples.en: The hard inquiry appeared next to the name of the lender I had contacted.
examples.zh: 这条「硬性征信查询」就列在我联系过的贷款机构名称旁。

collocations: a hard inquiry on your report

words.enDefinition: A review of credit information that does not affect scores

examples.en: The eligibility page described the initial check as a soft inquiry.
examples.zh: 资格查询页面称，初步核查属于「软性征信查询」。

examples.en: When I viewed my own report, the bureau listed the check as a soft inquiry.
examples.zh: 我查看自己的报告时，征信机构把这次查询列为「软性征信查询」。

words.enDefinition: An initial estimate of eligibility based on limited information

examples.en: The prequalification form asked for less information than the full application did.
examples.zh: 「初步资格评估」表格要求填写的信息比正式申请少。

examples.en: Her prequalification letter gave a possible rate and listed several conditions.
examples.zh: 她的「初步资格评估」信里写了一个可能适用的利率，还列出了几项条件。

words.enDefinition: An indication that a lender has provisionally approved an application

examples.en: The bank's preapproval letter said it still needed to verify my income.
examples.zh: 银行的「预先审批」通知说还需要核实我的收入。

examples.en: I asked how long the preapproval would remain valid while I compared offers.
examples.zh: 我问在比较不同报价期间，「预先审批」的结果能保留多久。

words.enDefinition: A formal request to borrow money or obtain a credit account

examples.en: I saved my credit application as a draft while looking for a recent payslip.
examples.zh: 我在找最近的工资单时，把「信贷申请」存成了草稿。

examples.en: The lender sent an email asking about one field on my credit application.
examples.zh: 贷款机构发来邮件，询问我「信贷申请」中的一项信息。

words.enDefinition: A US notice explaining an unfavorable decision on a credit application

examples.en: The US lender sent an adverse action notice after turning down my application.
examples.zh: 美国的贷款机构拒绝我的申请后，发来一份「信贷不利决定通知」。

examples.en: I kept the adverse action notice because it named the company that supplied my report.
examples.zh: 我保留了这份「信贷不利决定通知」，因为上面写着哪家公司提供了我的报告。

collocations: reasons in an adverse action notice

words.enDefinition: A formal challenge to information listed in a borrowing record

examples.en: My credit report dispute concerned a late payment that the lender had recorded by mistake.
examples.zh: 我提交的「信用报告异议」涉及一笔被贷款机构误记的逾期还款。

examples.en: I saved the case number after submitting a credit report dispute through the bureau's website.
examples.zh: 我在征信机构网站提交「信用报告异议」后，保存了案件编号。

words.enDefinition: An item whose accuracy or validity someone has formally challenged

examples.en: My disputed entry remained visible while the company investigated its source and accuracy.
examples.zh: 在公司调查来源和准确性期间，我那条「有异议的记录」仍然可见。

examples.en: The bureau's email listed the disputed entry by account name and date.
examples.zh: 征信机构在邮件中列出了这条「有异议的记录」的账户名称和日期。

words.enDefinition: A restriction on access to credit information for new applications

examples.en: The US bureau confirmed the credit freeze after I noticed an unfamiliar application.
examples.zh: 我发现一份陌生的申请后，美国的征信机构确认了「信用报告冻结」。

examples.en: I asked whether the credit freeze affected how I viewed my own report online.
examples.zh: 我问「信用报告冻结」是否会影响我在网上查看自己的报告。

words.enDefinition: A credit file notice requesting extra checks of an applicant's identity

examples.en: I asked the US credit bureau what a fraud alert would show to lenders.
examples.zh: 我问美国征信机构，贷款机构会在「欺诈警示」中看到什么。

examples.en: The bureau's message confirmed the fraud alert and gave its start date.
examples.zh: 征信机构的消息确认了「欺诈警示」，并写明开始日期。

words.enDefinition: A document recording that someone used another person's identity unlawfully

examples.en: The bureau asked for the identity theft report when I disputed the unfamiliar loan.
examples.zh: 我对那笔陌生贷款提出异议时，征信机构要求提供「身份盗用报告」。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the identity theft report next to the letters from the lender.
examples.zh: 我把「身份盗用报告」的副本和贷款机构的来信放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: Regular tracking of changes in someone's borrowing information or score

examples.en: The credit monitoring service notified me when a new account appeared on my report.
examples.zh: 报告上出现新账户时，「信用记录监测」服务通知了我。

examples.en: My bank's page described credit monitoring and showed what kinds of changes it tracks.
examples.zh: 银行的页面介绍了「信用记录监测」，并列出可监测哪些变化。

words.enDefinition: An account with a payment owed after its deadline

examples.en: The letter showed the past-due account number beside the current amount owed.
examples.zh: 信里把「逾期账户」的编号列在当前欠款金额旁。

examples.en: I asked the bank which month the past-due account first fell behind.
examples.zh: 我问银行这个「逾期账户」最早是从哪个月开始欠款的。

words.enDefinition: The number of days since a payment became overdue

examples.en: The table showed the days past due in a column next to the unpaid amount.
examples.zh: 表格把「逾期天数」列在未付金额旁边。

examples.en: My statement listed the days past due from the last bill, which I had already paid.
examples.zh: 我的账单仍显示上一期的「逾期天数」，但那期我已经付过了。

words.enDefinition: A scheduled payment that was not made on time

examples.en: The agent and I went through my statement to find the missed payment.
examples.zh: 工作人员和我一起查看账单，找那笔「漏缴款项」。

examples.en: A missed payment from March appeared on the report even after I updated my address.
examples.zh: 我更新地址后，报告上仍有三月那笔「漏缴款项」。

collocations: follow up on a missed payment

words.enDefinition: A payment received by its agreed or scheduled date

examples.en: The bank sent me a receipt to confirm my on-time payment in August.
examples.zh: 银行给我发来一张收据，确认我八月份「按时付款」。

examples.en: I showed the date of my on-time payment when I called about the fee.
examples.zh: 我打电话询问费用时，出示了「按时付款」的日期。

words.enDefinition: An account whose unpaid debt is being pursued for collection

examples.en: The report showed an account in collections that I did not recognize from my own records.
examples.zh: 报告上有一个「移交催收的账户」，我自己的记录里找不到。

examples.en: I asked the adviser what an account in collections meant on the report's first page.
examples.zh: 我请顾问解释报告第一页的「移交催收的账户」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A company that contacts people to recover money owed

examples.en: The debt collection agency sent a letter with a balance and the original lender's name.
examples.zh: 「债务催收机构」寄来一封信，写着欠款金额和原贷款机构的名称。

examples.en: I asked the debt collection agency which of my accounts its letter referred to.
examples.zh: 我问「债务催收机构」，来信指的是我的哪个账户。

collocations: refer a debt to a debt collection agency
letter from a debt collection agency

words.enDefinition: A written message about a debt being pursued for payment

examples.en: The collection notice showed a different balance from the one on my last statement.
examples.zh: 「催收通知」列出的欠款金额与我上一期账单不同。

examples.en: I put the collection notice in a folder with the loan agreement and receipts.
examples.zh: 我把「催收通知」与贷款协议和收据一起放进文件夹。

words.enDefinition: A lender's accounting action recording a debt as unlikely to be collected

examples.en: I asked the lender why the account charge-off was dated after my last payment.
examples.zh: 我问贷款机构，为什么「账户坏账核销」的日期在我上次还款之后。

examples.en: The report listed the account charge-off separately from the outstanding amount on the loan.
examples.zh: 报告把「账户坏账核销」与贷款尚欠金额分开列示。

words.enDefinition: An account closed under an agreement resolving the outstanding debt

examples.en: The settled account remained on the report with a note about the agreement.
examples.zh: 这个「已和解结清账户」仍在报告中，并附有说明协议的备注。

examples.en: I kept the letter showing the balance and date of the settled account.
examples.zh: 我保留了那封信，上面写有「已和解结清账户」的余额和结清日期。

collocations: mark an account as a settled account

words.enDefinition: The percentage of a revolving credit limit currently in use

examples.en: My report explained my credit utilization ratio beside the balances and limits of my cards.
examples.zh: 报告在信用卡余额和额度旁解释了我的「信用额度使用率」。

examples.en: I asked which balances had been used to calculate the credit utilization ratio shown online.
examples.zh: 我问网上显示的「信用额度使用率」是用哪些余额算出来的。

words.enDefinition: The amount someone can still borrow under an existing limit

examples.en: The app shows my available credit below the amount I already owe.
examples.zh: 应用在已欠金额下方显示我的「当前可用额度」。

examples.en: I asked why my available credit had changed before the latest purchase appeared online.
examples.zh: 我问信用卡最新一笔消费还没在网上显示，为什么「当前可用额度」就变了。

words.enDefinition: A change that raises the maximum amount a person can borrow

examples.en: The notice about my credit limit increase came with a new card agreement.
examples.zh: 关于「信用额度上调」的通知和一份新信用卡协议一起寄来了。

examples.en: The representative asked whether I had requested the credit limit increase shown on my account.
examples.zh: 客服问账户里显示的「信用额度上调」是否是我申请的。

words.enDefinition: The final day of the period covered by a statement

examples.en: My latest purchase appeared one day after the statement closing date listed on the bill.
examples.zh: 账单显示的「账单结算日」过了一天，最新那笔消费才入账。

examples.en: We checked the statement closing date because our payments fell in different billing periods.
examples.zh: 我们的还款分属不同账期，所以核对了「账单结算日」。

words.enDefinition: The recurring period of activity covered by a single bill

examples.en: My card's first billing cycle began the week the account was opened.
examples.zh: 我的信用卡第一个「账单周期」从开户那周开始。

examples.en: The hotel refunded the charge near the end of the billing cycle.
examples.zh: 酒店在「账单周期」快结束时退回了那笔费用。

words.enDefinition: The amount currently owed based on activity posted to an account

examples.en: I compared the current balance in the app with last month's printed statement.
examples.zh: 我把应用里的「当前欠款余额」与上月的纸质账单做了比较。

examples.en: A refund appeared this morning and changed the current balance on my card.
examples.zh: 今天上午一笔退款入账，改变了信用卡的「当前欠款余额」。

words.enDefinition: The portion of a bill that remains unpaid after its deadline

examples.en: The letter listed the past due amount above the payment for the current month.
examples.zh: 信中把「逾期未付金额」列在本月应付款上方。

examples.en: I asked whether the past due amount already included the fee listed below it.
examples.zh: 我问「逾期未付金额」是否已经包括下方列出的那笔费用。

words.enDefinition: The smallest amount due for a particular billing period

examples.en: The minimum payment was printed beside the date my payment was due.
examples.zh: 「最低还款额」印在我的还款到期日旁边。

examples.en: I asked why the minimum payment changed when the balance barely moved.
examples.zh: 我问欠款余额几乎没变，为什么「最低还款额」变了。

words.enDefinition: A periodic summary of card transactions, charges, payments, and amounts owed

examples.en: I downloaded my credit card statement to check when the refund had been posted.
examples.zh: 我下载了「信用卡账单」，查看退款哪天入账。

examples.en: The agent found the charge near the bottom of my credit card statement.
examples.zh: 客服在我的「信用卡账单」接近底部的位置找到了那笔扣款。

words.enDefinition: A transaction that has not appeared on a completed bill

examples.en: The grocery purchase showed up as an unbilled transaction on my card account.
examples.zh: 那笔超市消费在我的信用卡账户上显示为「未出账交易」。

examples.en: I asked whether the unbilled transaction would appear on this week's statement.
examples.zh: 我问这笔「未出账交易」是否会出现在本周的账单上。

words.enDefinition: A payment that has been entered in the account records

examples.en: The posted payment reduced the amount owed on my card overnight.
examples.zh: 这笔「已入账还款」使我信用卡的欠款在一夜之间减少了。

examples.en: I printed the screen because it showed the posted payment and its amount.
examples.zh: 我把页面打印了下来，因为上面显示了这笔「已入账还款」及其金额。

words.enDefinition: The date a payment is entered in an account's records

examples.en: The payment posting date was a day later than the date on my receipt.
examples.zh: 「还款入账日」比收据上的日期晚一天。

examples.en: The agent read back the payment posting date while we were checking the statement.
examples.zh: 我们核对账单时，客服复述了「还款入账日」。

words.enDefinition: The distribution of a payment across different balances or charges

examples.en: The statement showed the payment allocation across purchases, interest, and a cash advance.
examples.zh: 账单列出了消费欠款、利息和预借现金之间的「还款分配」。

examples.en: My lender explained the payment allocation with a breakdown of my latest installment.
examples.zh: 贷款机构把我最近一期的还款逐项拆分，解释了「还款分配」。

words.enDefinition: Money applied toward the amount borrowed rather than associated costs

examples.en: The receipt showed my principal payment on a separate line from the interest.
examples.zh: 收据把「偿还本金的款项」和利息分行列出。

examples.en: I asked why the principal payment was smaller than the amount I sent.
examples.zh: 我问为什么「偿还本金的款项」比我汇出的总额少。

words.enDefinition: An amount added to an account for borrowing money

examples.en: The interest charge on this statement was higher than the one last month.
examples.zh: 这期账单的「利息费用」比上个月高。

examples.en: I called to ask why the interest charge was split across two lines.
examples.zh: 我打电话问为什么「利息费用」分成了两行。

collocations: an interest charge on your statement

words.enDefinition: The cost of borrowing, including interest and certain other charges

examples.en: The disclosure listed a finance charge beside the amount I planned to borrow.
examples.zh: 披露文件在我计划借款的金额旁列出了「信贷费用」。

examples.en: The adviser explained which fees the finance charge included for this loan.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了这笔贷款的「信贷费用」包括哪些费用。

words.enDefinition: The annualized interest rate charged on a card's purchase balance

examples.en: My statement showed a different purchase APR after the promotional period ended.
examples.zh: 优惠期结束后，账单上显示了不同的「刷卡消费年利率」。

examples.en: Can you show me where the purchase APR appears in the agreement?
examples.zh: 你能指给我看协议里哪一处写着「刷卡消费年利率」吗？

words.enDefinition: The annualized interest rate applied when cash is borrowed on a card

examples.en: The disclosure showed the cash advance APR in a separate column from the purchase rate.
examples.zh: 披露文件把「预借现金年利率」与消费利率分列两栏。

examples.en: I asked whether the cash advance APR applied to the transaction listed as cash.
examples.zh: 我问「预借现金年利率」是否适用于那笔列为现金的交易。

words.enDefinition: A temporary annualized rate offered when a credit account begins

examples.en: The offer gave an introductory APR and showed when the regular rate would begin.
examples.zh: 报价列出了「首期优惠年利率」，并写明何时开始按常规利率计息。

examples.en: I could see the last day of my introductory APR in the app.
examples.zh: 我能在应用里看到「首期优惠年利率」的最后一天。

words.enDefinition: An annualized borrowing rate that can change over time

examples.en: The agreement said the variable APR could change along with a benchmark rate.
examples.zh: 协议说「浮动年利率」可能随某个基准利率变化。

examples.en: I asked why the variable APR on my latest statement was different.
examples.zh: 我问为什么最近一期账单上的「浮动年利率」变了。

collocations: purchase balance with a variable APR

words.enDefinition: A higher annualized rate charged when certain account terms are broken

examples.en: The US card agreement explained when a penalty APR might be applied.
examples.zh: 美国这份信用卡协议解释了哪些情况下可能适用「惩罚性年利率」。

examples.en: The letter said my penalty APR would appear on the next statement.
examples.zh: 信里说我的「惩罚性年利率」将在下一期账单上显示。

words.enDefinition: A span of time when an eligible balance does not accrue interest

examples.en: The brochure used a calendar to show when the interest-free period ended.
examples.zh: 宣传册用日历标明了「免息期」什么时候结束。

examples.en: I asked whether the card's interest-free period applied to this kind of transaction.
examples.zh: 我问信用卡的「免息期」是否适用于这种交易。

words.enDefinition: Interest accumulated before repayment that appears on a later statement

examples.en: The last bill showed trailing interest even though I had paid the previous balance.
examples.zh: 虽然我已经还清上期余额，最后一张账单还是显示了「残余利息」。

examples.en: The card issuer explained which dates the trailing interest on my statement covered.
examples.zh: 发卡机构解释了账单上的「残余利息」对应哪些日期。

collocations: trailing interest on the final bill

words.enDefinition: A charge for getting cash using a credit account

examples.en: The cash withdrawal receipt did not show the card issuer's cash advance fee.
examples.zh: 现金取款凭条没显示发卡机构收取的「预借现金手续费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the cash advance fee and the ATM fee were separate charges.
examples.zh: 我问「预借现金手续费」和 ATM 手续费是不是两项费用。

words.enDefinition: The movement of an existing card debt to another account

examples.en: The app showed the balance transfer as pending while both card balances still matched yesterday's figures.
examples.zh: 应用显示「信用卡欠款转移」还在处理中，两张卡的欠款余额仍和昨天一样。

examples.en: I called the issuer to ask when the balance transfer would appear on my statement.
examples.zh: 我打电话问发卡机构，「信用卡欠款转移」什么时候会出现在账单上。

words.enDefinition: A charge for moving card debt to another account

examples.en: The balance transfer fee appeared on the first statement from my new card.
examples.zh: 「欠款转移手续费」出现在我新信用卡的第一期账单里。

examples.en: I asked whether the quoted amount included the balance transfer fee shown in the offer.
examples.zh: 我问报价金额是否包含方案中列出的「欠款转移手续费」。

words.enDefinition: A yearly charge for having a card account

examples.en: The annual card fee appeared in the month I first opened the account.
examples.zh: 「信用卡年费」出现在我开立账户当月的账单里。

examples.en: I called to ask whether the annual card fee changed after the first year.
examples.zh: 我打电话询问第一年过后「信用卡年费」会不会变化。

words.enDefinition: A charge when an attempted payment is sent back unpaid

examples.en: I saw a returned payment fee after the bank sent my payment back.
examples.zh: 银行退回我的还款之后，我看到一笔「还款退回手续费」。

examples.en: The card issuer explained the returned payment fee listed beside my reversed payment.
examples.zh: 发卡机构解释了那笔撤销的还款旁边列出的「还款退回手续费」。

words.enDefinition: A charge for exceeding a card account's permitted borrowing limit

examples.en: The statement showed an over-limit fee next to the card's new balance.
examples.zh: 账单在信用卡的新余额旁列了一笔「超额费用」。

examples.en: The agreement explains when an over-limit fee might appear on a statement.
examples.zh: 协议解释了何时账单上可能出现「超额费用」。

words.enDefinition: The percentage rate used to express borrowing interest per month

examples.en: The leaflet gave a monthly interest rate alongside a figure for the entire year.
examples.zh: 宣传册在全年利率旁边也列出了「月利率」。

examples.en: I asked whether the monthly interest rate in the example was fixed or variable.
examples.zh: 我问例子里的「月利率」是固定的还是浮动的。

words.enDefinition: The rate applied to a balance when calculating daily interest

examples.en: The US card agreement listed the daily periodic rate under a section about interest.
examples.zh: 这份美国信用卡协议在利息一节列出了「日计息利率」。

examples.en: I asked what the daily periodic rate on the last page was used for.
examples.zh: 我问最后一页的「日计息利率」是用来做什么的。

words.enDefinition: The mean of an account's balances across the days in a period

examples.en: The issuer used the average daily balance to calculate the interest on my purchases.
examples.zh: 发卡机构用「日均余额」来计算我的刷卡消费利息。

examples.en: The PDF showed the billing dates next to my average daily balance for the month.
examples.zh: PDF 在本月的「日均余额」旁列出了账单起止日期。

words.enDefinition: A payment made automatically according to previously selected instructions

examples.en: The app showed a scheduled automatic payment for the middle of next week.
examples.zh: 应用显示有一笔「自动还款」安排在下周中间几天。

examples.en: I checked the amount of my automatic payment after the new statement arrived.
examples.zh: 新账单出来后，我核对了「自动还款」的金额。

words.enDefinition: To pay the entire amount owed on a bill

examples.en: The app asks whether I want to pay in full or choose another amount.
examples.zh: 应用问我是想「全额还款」，还是想选择其他金额。

examples.en: Will the confirmation say I chose to pay in full for this month's bill?
examples.zh: 确认信息会写明我选择对本月账单「全额还款」吗？

collocations: pay in full by the due date

words.enDefinition: To leave part of an outstanding amount unpaid into another period

examples.en: I sometimes carry a balance when my pay arrives after the next billing cycle begins.
examples.zh: 工资在新账期开始后才到账时，我有时会「留有未还清欠款」。

examples.en: The guide explains what happens if you carry a balance from the previous month.
examples.zh: 指南解释了如果上个月「留有未还清欠款」会发生什么。

collocations: carry a balance from month to month
carry a balance on a card

words.enDefinition: To reduce the amount owed through one or more payments

examples.en: The example showed how two small payments can pay down a balance over several weeks.
examples.zh: 例子展示了怎样通过两笔小额还款，在几周内「逐步偿还欠款」。

examples.en: I watched the total fall as I used spare cash to pay down a balance.
examples.zh: 我用手头的闲钱「逐步偿还欠款」，看着总欠款慢慢下降。

collocations: pay down a balance on a card

words.enDefinition: To pay an additional amount beyond what is scheduled

examples.en: The agent explained what the receipt would show if I chose to make an extra payment.
examples.zh: 客服解释了如果我选择「额外还一笔款」，收据上会显示什么。

examples.en: I asked whether I could make an extra payment through the same page as usual.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在平常用的页面上「额外还一笔款」。

collocations: make an extra payment toward principal
make an extra payment this month

words.enDefinition: A message that tells someone that a payment is coming due

examples.en: The payment reminder arrived on my phone while I was studying at the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆学习时，手机收到了「还款提醒」。

examples.en: I checked the date in the payment reminder against the latest statement.
examples.zh: 我拿最新一期账单核对了「还款提醒」里的日期。

words.enDefinition: Account summaries delivered electronically instead of as paper copies

examples.en: I selected paperless statements so the monthly card bills would appear online.
examples.zh: 我选择了「电子账单」，这样每月的信用卡账单就会在网上显示。

examples.en: I saved the email confirming my switch to paperless statements last week.
examples.zh: 我保存了上周那封确认改用「电子账单」的邮件。

words.enDefinition: Money borrowed by an individual for a private purpose

examples.en: The credit union listed the repayment terms for a personal loan online.
examples.zh: 信用合作社把「个人贷款」的还款条款放在了网上。

examples.en: I asked which fees the lender included in its personal loan quote.
examples.zh: 我问贷款机构的「个人贷款」报价包含哪些费用。

words.enDefinition: A loan that does not require property pledged as security

examples.en: The booklet included examples of an unsecured loan and a loan backed by property.
examples.zh: 手册介绍了「无抵押贷款」和以财产作担保的贷款的例子。

examples.en: This offer for an unsecured loan listed the total repayment amount separately.
examples.zh: 这份「无抵押贷款」报价单独列出了还款总额。

words.enDefinition: Borrowed money backed by an asset pledged to the lender

examples.en: The application for a secured loan asked for information about the car.
examples.zh: 这份「有抵押贷款」申请要求填写汽车的相关信息。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where the secured loan terms described the pledged property.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看「有抵押贷款」条款中哪一处描述了抵押财产。

collocations: a secured loan against a vehicle

words.enDefinition: The sum of money borrowed under a lending agreement

examples.en: The form showed my loan amount above the estimate for each monthly payment.
examples.zh: 表格把我的「贷款金额」列在每月预计还款额上方。

examples.en: I asked whether the loan amount included the fee shown on the next line.
examples.zh: 我问「贷款金额」是否包括下一行显示的费用。

words.enDefinition: The original money borrowed, excluding the associated interest and charges

examples.en: The disclosure listed the loan principal separately from the total amount to repay.
examples.zh: 披露文件把「贷款本金」与还款总额分开列出。

examples.en: Part of each installment went toward the loan principal according to the schedule.
examples.zh: 按还款表，每期有一部分款项用于偿还「贷款本金」。

words.enDefinition: The agreed period over which borrowed money is to be repaid

examples.en: The letter showed the loan term in months beside the final repayment date.
examples.zh: 信上把以月计的「贷款期限」列在最后还款日旁边。

examples.en: I asked whether changing the loan term would affect the quoted monthly payment.
examples.zh: 我问更改「贷款期限」是否会影响报价上的每月还款额。

words.enDefinition: Borrowed money on which the contracted rate remains the same

examples.en: With this fixed-rate loan, the stated interest rate stays the same throughout the term.
examples.zh: 这笔「固定利率贷款」的约定利率在整个期限内保持不变。

examples.en: The quote for a fixed-rate loan arrived with a table of scheduled payments.
examples.zh: 「固定利率贷款」的报价和一份定期还款表一同发来。

words.enDefinition: Borrowed money on which the contracted rate may change over time

examples.en: The statement explained why the interest on my variable-rate loan changed last month.
examples.zh: 账单解释了我的「浮动利率贷款」上个月为什么调整了利息。

examples.en: The example for a variable-rate loan showed two possible monthly payment amounts.
examples.zh: 「浮动利率贷款」的示例列出了两个可能的每月还款额。

words.enDefinition: A flexible borrowing arrangement allowing repeated draws within a limit

examples.en: The app listed my personal line of credit under borrowing rather than savings.
examples.zh: 应用把我的「个人循环信贷额度」列在借款栏，而非储蓄栏。

examples.en: I asked whether the personal line of credit had a separate statement from my other accounts.
examples.zh: 我问「个人循环信贷额度」的账单是否和其他账户分开。

collocations: open a personal line of credit
draw on a personal line of credit
repay a personal line of credit

words.enDefinition: A contract setting out the conditions of a loan

examples.en: I searched the loan agreement for the section about changing my payment date.
examples.zh: 我在「贷款协议」里找更改还款日期的条款。

examples.en: The office sent a copy of the loan agreement after our appointment.
examples.zh: 预约办完后，办事处发来一份「贷款协议」副本。

words.enDefinition: A lender's proposal stating the terms on which it would lend

examples.en: The loan offer listed the repayment amount and the date it would expire.
examples.zh: 「贷款要约」列出了应还金额和要约失效日期。

examples.en: She asked which conditions in the loan offer still needed to be met.
examples.zh: 她问「贷款要约」里还有哪些条件需要满足。

words.enDefinition: A person who receives money with an obligation to repay it

examples.en: The first page of the contract gave the borrower a contact number.
examples.zh: 合同第一页为「借款人」提供了一个联系电话。

examples.en: The borrower asked for a copy of the agreement before leaving.
examples.zh: 「借款人」离开前要了一份协议副本。

words.enDefinition: A person who signs a loan and shares responsibility for repayment

examples.en: The form included a separate signature line for each co-borrower.
examples.zh: 表格为每位「共同借款人」都单独留了一栏签名。

examples.en: The bank sent a copy of the statement to each co-borrower.
examples.zh: 银行给每位「共同借款人」都发了一份账单副本。

words.enDefinition: A person who agrees to repay if the borrower does not

examples.en: The loan guarantor asked which part of the agreement described their obligations.
examples.zh: 「贷款担保人」问协议的哪一部分写明了其义务。

examples.en: I asked the adviser why the form required a loan guarantor for this offer.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，为什么这份方案的表格要求填写一位「贷款担保人」。

words.enDefinition: The conditions someone must meet to qualify for a loan

examples.en: The bank listed its loan eligibility requirements on the same page as the application.
examples.zh: 银行在申请表所在的页面列出了「贷款申请资格」要求。

examples.en: I asked how the lender assessed loan eligibility for people with irregular income.
examples.zh: 我问贷款机构如何评估收入不固定人士的「贷款申请资格」。

words.enDefinition: The share of monthly gross income taken by debt payments

examples.en: The guide explained why each monthly debt payment counted toward the debt-to-income ratio.
examples.zh: 指南解释了为何每笔每月的还债款项都计入「债务收入比」。

examples.en: The adviser explained which income figures went into the debt-to-income ratio shown there.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了界面显示的「债务收入比」涉及哪些收入数据。

words.enDefinition: Checking documents or records to confirm how much someone earns

examples.en: The lender requested two months of payslips for income verification during my application.
examples.zh: 我申请贷款时，贷款机构要求提交两个月的工资单，用于「收入核实」。

examples.en: The application showed income verification as complete but still listed one missing document.
examples.zh: 申请页面显示「收入核实」已完成，但仍有一份材料没有提交。

words.enDefinition: The release of borrowed funds by the lender

examples.en: The message gave the date of the loan disbursement and the amount transferred.
examples.zh: 消息写明了「贷款发放」的日期和转入金额。

examples.en: I asked where the confirmation of loan disbursement would appear in my account.
examples.zh: 我问账户的什么位置会显示「贷款发放」的确认信息。

words.enDefinition: The money a borrower receives from an approved loan

examples.en: The loan proceeds appeared in my account the day after the letter arrived.
examples.zh: 通知信送到后的第二天，「贷款所得款项」入了我的账户。

examples.en: The receipt listed the loan proceeds and a separate line for the fee.
examples.zh: 收据列出了「贷款所得款项」，另有一行列出了费用。

words.enDefinition: One scheduled payment that repays part of a loan

examples.en: The loan installment appeared on my statement alongside the remaining loan balance.
examples.zh: 账单上列出了这「一期贷款还款」的金额及剩余贷款余额。

examples.en: I asked when the final loan installment was due under the original agreement.
examples.zh: 我问按原协议，最后「一期贷款还款」何时到期。

words.enDefinition: A timetable showing the amounts and dates of planned repayments

examples.en: The repayment schedule listed each expected payment all the way through next June.
examples.zh: 「还款时间表」列出了到明年六月为止的每一笔计划还款。

examples.en: I noticed a different date in the updated repayment schedule the bank sent.
examples.zh: 我发现银行发来的新版「还款时间表」中有个日期变了。

words.enDefinition: A timetable breaking payments into principal and interest over time

examples.en: The amortization schedule showed that my first payment went mostly toward interest.
examples.zh: 「本息分摊表」显示，我第一期还款大部分用于支付利息。

examples.en: I used the amortization schedule to find the remaining balance after my last payment.
examples.zh: 我根据「本息分摊表」查到上期还款后的剩余本金。

words.enDefinition: The part of the original borrowed amount still to be repaid

examples.en: The principal balance decreased after the lender recorded my most recent payment.
examples.zh: 贷款机构记下我最近一笔还款后，「剩余本金」减少了。

examples.en: I found the principal balance under a separate heading from the interest due.
examples.zh: 我在有别于应付利息的另一个栏目下找到了「剩余本金」。

words.enDefinition: The borrowed amount together with the interest charged on it

examples.en: The chart showed how principal and interest made up each of my monthly payments.
examples.zh: 图表展示了我每月还款中的「本金和利息」各占多少。

examples.en: I asked whether the amount for principal and interest included any separate charges.
examples.zh: 我问「本金和利息」的金额是否包含另收的费用。

words.enDefinition: A company that manages repayments and records for a lender

examples.en: My loan servicer sent a letter explaining where future statements would appear.
examples.zh: 我的「贷款服务机构」发来一封信，说明今后在哪儿能看到账单。

examples.en: I asked the loan servicer for a receipt showing the payment date.
examples.zh: 我向「贷款服务机构」索取了一张显示还款日期的收据。

words.enDefinition: The total needed to clear a debt on a particular date

examples.en: The payoff amount was different from the principal shown in the app.
examples.zh: 「一次性结清金额」与应用中显示的剩余本金不同。

examples.en: The lender explained which charges were included in the quoted payoff amount.
examples.zh: 贷款机构解释了报价的「一次性结清金额」包含哪些费用。

words.enDefinition: A dated estimate of the amount needed to clear a debt

examples.en: The payoff quote showed the total I would owe through next Wednesday.
examples.zh: 「结清报价单」列出了我截至下周三全额还清需支付的总额。

examples.en: I kept the payoff quote because it listed the amount and the date together.
examples.zh: 我保留了「结清报价单」，因为上面同时列出了金额和日期。

words.enDefinition: Paying back some or all borrowed money before scheduled dates

examples.en: The agreement had a short section about early repayment near the back.
examples.zh: 协议快到末尾的地方有一小节讲「提前还款」。

examples.en: I asked the lender whether early repayment changed the remaining payment schedule.
examples.zh: 我问贷款机构，「提前还款」是否会改变剩余还款计划。

words.enDefinition: A charge for paying all or part of a loan ahead of schedule

examples.en: The US contract said when a prepayment penalty could apply to the loan.
examples.zh: 这份美国合同写明了贷款在什么情况下可能收取「提前还款违约金」。

examples.en: I asked whether the prepayment penalty appeared anywhere in the payoff quote.
examples.zh: 我问结清报价单上有没有列出「提前还款违约金」。

words.enDefinition: Repaying some of a loan before that amount is due

examples.en: The updated statement showed my partial prepayment next to the new principal balance.
examples.zh: 更新后的账单把我的「部分提前还款」列在新的剩余本金旁。

examples.en: I asked whether a partial prepayment would change the dates on my remaining payments.
examples.zh: 我问「部分提前还款」是否会改变余下各期的还款日期。

collocations: apply a partial prepayment to principal

words.enDefinition: A charge for processing and issuing a new loan

examples.en: The loan origination fee was shown on a separate line in the quote.
examples.zh: 「贷款发放手续费」在报价单上单独列了一行。

examples.en: I asked whether the loan origination fee would be deducted from the funds I received.
examples.zh: 我问「贷款发放手续费」是否会从我实际收到的款项里扣除。

words.enDefinition: An Australian annualized rate combining loan interest with most fees

examples.en: The Australian leaflet showed a comparison rate beside the advertised interest rate.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这份宣传册把「含费比较利率」列在广告利率旁边。

examples.en: I asked which fees the comparison rate included in the lender's example.
examples.zh: 我问贷款机构的例子里，「含费比较利率」包括哪些费用。

collocations: comparison rate for a personal loan

words.enDefinition: All money payable over a loan, including principal and borrowing costs

examples.en: The UK agreement showed the total amount repayable below the monthly figure.
examples.zh: 这份英国协议把「还款总额」列在每月还款额下方。

examples.en: I checked whether the total amount repayable included the fee on the first page.
examples.zh: 我核对了「还款总额」是否包括第一页上的那项费用。

words.enDefinition: All interest already paid over the stated period or loan term

examples.en: The year-end statement showed the total interest paid under a separate heading.
examples.zh: 年末账单把「已付利息总额」列在单独的栏目下。

examples.en: I compared my total interest paid with the figure on last year's statement.
examples.zh: 我把自己的「已付利息总额」与去年账单上的数字做了比较。

words.enDefinition: The interest and fees payable for borrowing, excluding the amount borrowed

examples.en: The guide put the total cost of credit in a separate box from the borrowed amount.
examples.zh: 指南把「信贷成本总额」和借款金额放在不同的框里。

examples.en: I asked which charges were counted toward the total cost of credit in the quote.
examples.zh: 我问报价单中哪些费用计入了「信贷成本总额」。

collocations: calculate the total cost of credit
disclose the total cost of credit
compare the total cost of credit

words.enDefinition: A card backed by a deposit that secures the account

examples.en: The application for a secured credit card explained where the deposit would be held.
examples.zh: 「押金担保信用卡」的申请说明解释了押金会存放在哪里。

examples.en: The issuer explained when it could return the deposit for my secured credit card.
examples.zh: 发卡机构解释了什么时候可以退还我的「押金担保信用卡」押金。

collocations: apply for a secured credit card

words.enDefinition: A loan designed primarily to help establish a repayment record

examples.en: The US credit union explained how its credit builder loan appeared on credit reports.
examples.zh: 这家美国信用合作社解释了它的「信用记录建立贷款」如何显示在信用报告中。

examples.en: I asked what would happen to the funds under the credit builder loan agreement.
examples.zh: 我问按「信用记录建立贷款」协议，这笔资金会怎么处理。

collocations: payments on a credit builder loan

words.enDefinition: An agreement or arrangement to postpone a scheduled payment

examples.en: The lender's letter confirmed the new due date after the payment deferral.
examples.zh: 贷款机构的信确认了「延期还款」后的新到期日。

examples.en: I asked whether interest would accrue during the agreed payment deferral.
examples.zh: 我问在约定的「延期还款」期间是否还会计息。

words.enDefinition: Adjusted repayment terms agreed because someone cannot meet regular obligations

examples.en: The Australian lender asked how long I needed the hardship arrangement to last.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的贷款机构问我需要这项「财务困难还款安排」持续多久。

examples.en: The letter set out my monthly payments under the hardship arrangement we discussed.
examples.zh: 信里列出了我们讨论过的「财务困难还款安排」下我每月要还的金额。

words.enDefinition: Guidance on credit, debt, and managing regular repayments

examples.en: The campus adviser gave me the number for a credit counseling service.
examples.zh: 学校顾问把一家「信用与债务咨询」服务的电话给了我。

examples.en: My credit counseling session covered the dates and balances on my statements.
examples.zh: 在「信用与债务咨询」时，顾问和我一起核对了账单上的日期和金额。

words.enDefinition: Loan payments that remain unpaid after their agreed deadlines

examples.en: The letter showed the loan arrears separately from this month's scheduled payment.
examples.zh: 信里把「贷款逾期欠款」与本月应还款项分开列出。

examples.en: I asked which two missed payments were included in the loan arrears.
examples.zh: 我问「贷款逾期欠款」包括哪两笔漏缴的还款。

collocations: the amount of the loan arrears

words.enDefinition: Failure to fulfill a major repayment obligation under a loan agreement

examples.en: The adviser explained how the agreement defined a loan default for this account.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了协议如何界定这个账户上的「贷款违约」。

examples.en: I found the loan default section in the copy of my contract.
examples.zh: 我在合同副本里找到了关于「贷款违约」的章节。

words.enDefinition: A message saying a required payment remains unpaid after its deadline

examples.en: I received a past-due notice and checked it against my payment receipt.
examples.zh: 我收到了「逾期付款通知」，便拿出付款凭据核对。

examples.en: The past-due notice listed a balance from before the lender recorded my payment.
examples.zh: 「逾期付款通知」列出的是贷款机构给我那笔还款入账前的欠款余额。

words.enDefinition: A US collection notice giving debt information and dispute rights

examples.en: The US collector's debt validation notice named the company it said I owed.
examples.zh: 美国催收机构的「债务核实通知」写明了它声称我欠款的公司。

examples.en: I read the instructions for disputing the balance in the debt validation notice.
examples.zh: 我看了「债务核实通知」里对余额提出异议的说明。

words.enDefinition: Replacing an existing loan with another under different terms

examples.en: The brochure explained the fees associated with loan refinancing for a vehicle.
examples.zh: 宣传册解释了汽车「贷款再融资」涉及的费用。

examples.en: I asked whether the loan refinancing quote included a charge for closing the old loan.
examples.zh: 我问「贷款再融资」报价是否包括结清原贷款的费用。

words.enDefinition: Combining multiple debts into a single account or repayment arrangement

examples.en: The adviser explained debt consolidation using three balances from a sample statement.
examples.zh: 顾问用示例账单中的三笔欠款解释了「债务合并」。

examples.en: I asked which debts the debt consolidation offer would cover under its terms.
examples.zh: 我问按这份「债务合并」方案的条款，它能涵盖哪些债务。

words.enDefinition: How often payments are scheduled under a repayment agreement

examples.en: The form let me choose a repayment frequency before showing the estimated amounts.
examples.zh: 表格让我选定「还款频率」后才显示预计还款金额。

examples.en: The adviser confirmed my repayment frequency and read out the next payment date.
examples.zh: 顾问确认了我的「还款频率」，并念出了下次还款日期。

words.enDefinition: The date by which the loan is scheduled to be fully repaid

examples.en: The loan maturity date was listed next to the number of payments left.
examples.zh: 「贷款到期日」列在剩余还款次数旁边。

examples.en: I asked whether the loan maturity date changed when they updated the schedule.
examples.zh: 我问他们更新还款计划后，「贷款到期日」是否变了。

words.enDefinition: in UK credit advertising, an annual percentage rate the advertiser expects at least 51% of resulting credit agreements to receive at that rate or lower

examples.en: The UK advertisement displayed a representative APR directly below the borrowing example.
examples.zh: 英国的广告在借款示例正下方显示了「代表性年化利率」。

examples.en: I asked why my quote differed from the advertised representative APR.
examples.zh: 我问为什么我的报价和广告中的「代表性年化利率」不同。

words.enDefinition: The highest interest rate allowed by an agreement or rule

examples.en: The agreement described an interest rate cap in the section about future changes.
examples.zh: 协议在介绍未来可能调整的条款中说明了「利率上限」。

examples.en: I asked what the interest rate cap meant for the rate shown on my statement.
examples.zh: 我问「利率上限」对账单上显示的利率意味着什么。

words.enDefinition: A written notice saying that obligations under an agreement were breached

examples.en: The notice of default referred to a missed payment under the original agreement.
examples.zh: 「违约通知」提到一笔按原协议应付却漏缴的还款。

examples.en: I compared the account number on the notice of default with my contract.
examples.zh: 我核对了「违约通知」和合同上的账户号是否一致。

collocations: respond to a notice of default
